scientific_integrity: The exact Fourier, cyclotomic, geometric-sum and Kronecker argument establishes the stated all-order result; finite tests supplement rather than replace proof. Known phase-induced zero-transfer examples are credited.
scientific_limitations: No complete classification of algebraic-tangent exceptional phases in power-of-two cycles; phase-uniform quantitative bound not proved optimal; no transfer-time rate. Literature comparisons cannot rule out unindexed equivalent results.
title: Generic-flux antipodal transfer dichotomy on even magnetic cycles
